tool_schemas.name: list_dashboards
tool_schemas.description: Lists dashboards visible through the given Metabase connection, applying optional status/archived/search filters and returning a sorted, cursor-paginated page of dashboard records up to limit with an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when connection_id is malformed, limit/cursor/sort/order/status values are invalid, or unsupported filters are provided. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the connection cannot be used by the caller, NOT_FOUND when the connection_id does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller has exhausted list/read quotas for the connection.

connection_id.description: Metabase connection id to list dashboards from.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on dashboard name/description.

limit.description: Maximum number of dashboards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_cards
tool_schemas.description: Lists Metabase questions/cards for the connection, optionally filtered by database_id, status/archived/query_type and search, and returns results sorted as requested and paged via limit plus an opaque next cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enums (status/query_type/sort/order), invalid limit/cursor, or a database_id that does not match the provided connection_id. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the connection is not accessible to the caller, NOT_FOUND when the connection_id (or specified database_id) does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when read/list quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Metabase connection id to list cards from.

database_id.description: Filter cards to a specific stored Metabase database (internal id).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on card name/description.

limit.description: Maximum number of cards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_databases
tool_schemas.description: Lists databases configured in the connected Metabase instance, optionally filtered by status, is_sample, engine, and search, and returns a sorted, cursor-paginated page of database records up to limit with an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when connection_id is malformed, filter/sort/order values are invalid, or limit/cursor are out of bounds. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot use the connection, NOT_FOUND when the connection_id does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller exceeds allowed listing volume.

connection_id.description: Metabase connection id to list databases from.

is_sample.description: Filter by whether database is the Metabase sample dataset.

engine.description: Filter by database engine (e.g., postgres, mysql).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on database name.

limit.description: Maximum number of databases to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: execute_card
tool_schemas.description: Executes a saved Metabase card (by stored card_id or metabase_card_id) through the specified connection and returns the query result up to max_rows along with execution metadata, subject to timeout_ms. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when IDs are malformed/invalid, max_rows or timeout_ms are out of range, the parameter payload is invalid for the card, or neither card_id nor metabase_card_id can be resolved. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot execute queries on the connection, NOT_FOUND when the connection or card does not exist (or is deleted_remote), CONFLICT when the card is archived or otherwise not executable in its current state, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when execution or row/timeout quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Metabase connection id to execute the card against.

metabase_card_id.description: Metabase-native card id to execute (if not using card_id).

parameters.description: Parameter values for the card execution (Metabase parameter payload).

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the result.

timeout_ms.description: Client-side timeout in milliseconds for the execution.

tool_schemas.name: get_dashboard_cards
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cards linked to a dashboard (by stored dashboard_id or metabase_dashboard_id), optionally filtered by link status, sorted as requested, and paged with limit and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when IDs are malformed/invalid, sort/order/status values are invalid, or limit/cursor are out of bounds. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot read the connection’s dashboards, NOT_FOUND when the connection or dashboard does not exist (or is deleted_remote), and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when list/read quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Metabase connection id the dashboard belongs to.

metabase_dashboard_id.description: Metabase-native dashboard id (if not using dashboard_id).

sort.description: Field to sort dashboard cards by.

limit.description: Maximum number of dashboard cards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: execute_query
tool_schemas.description: Executes an ad-hoc native SQL query (native_sql) against a selected Metabase database (by stored database_id or metabase_database_id) and returns the result up to max_rows with execution metadata, subject to timeout_ms. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when native_sql is empty/invalid, IDs are malformed/invalid, max_rows or timeout_ms are out of range, parameters payload is invalid, or no resolvable database is provided for the connection. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller cannot execute queries on the connection, NOT_FOUND when the connection or target database does not exist (or is unavailable), CONFLICT when the target database is archived/unavailable for execution, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when execution, time, or row quotas are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Metabase connection id to execute the query against.

database_id.description: Stored Metabase database id (internal id) to run the SQL against.

metabase_database_id.description: Metabase-native database id to run the SQL against (if not using database_id).

native_sql.description: SQL string to execute as a native query.

parameters.description: Optional query parameters (Metabase native query parameter payload).

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the result.

timeout_ms.description: Client-side timeout in milliseconds for the execution.

tool_schemas.name: get_query_execution
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single query execution log record by id, including status, timing, and results metadata (columns/preview) when available. Refuses if the execution does not exist, does not belong to the provided connection, or the caller is not permitted to access it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs.

connection_id.description: Metabase connection id that owns the execution.

tool_schemas.name: list_query_executions
tool_schemas.description: Lists query execution log records for a connection with optional filtering by status, execution_type, card/database, and time range, returning a sorted, cursor-paginated page. Refuses invalid filters and refuses access when the caller lacks permission for the connection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enums, or invalid time range.

connection_id.description: Metabase connection id to list executions from.

card_id.description: Filter to executions for a specific stored card id.

database_id.description: Filter to executions for a specific stored database id.

started_after.description: Only include executions with started_at >= this timestamp.

started_before.description: Only include executions with started_at <= this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of executions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_query_execution
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of an in-flight query execution and updates the execution status according to lifecycle rules. If the execution is in status='queued' or 'running', transitions it to 'cancelled', sets finished_at, and computes duration_ms. If the execution is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled), it refuses with CONFLICT and does not change the record. Refuses when the connection is not active. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs.

connection_id.description: Metabase connection id that owns the execution.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for cancellation to aid audit/troubleshooting.

tool_schemas.name: create_metabase_connection
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Metabase connection configuration used by other endpoints to list objects and execute queries. Stores credentials by reference (secret refs) or username/password depending on auth_type. Returns the created connection record. Refuses invalid base_url/auth_type combinations, missing required credentials for the chosen auth_type, or unauthorized callers. Newly created connections start in status='active' unless validation/healthcheck fails, in which case status may be set to 'error' with last_healthcheck_error populated.

base_url.description: Base URL of the Metabase instance (e.g., https://metabase.example.com).

auth_type.description: How this connection authenticates to Metabase.

password_secret_ref.description: Secret reference that resolves to the Metabase password when auth_type='password'.

api_key_secret_ref.description: Secret reference that resolves to the Metabase API key/session token when auth_type='api_key'.

tool_schemas.name: update_metabase_connection
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Metabase connection (e.g., name, base_url, credentials) and/or transitions its status according to lifecycle rules. Returns the updated connection record. Refuses status transitions not allowed by the lifecycle, and refuses updates when the caller is not permitted. Credentials are updated by providing the relevant fields for the connection's auth_type; unspecified fields are left unchanged.

auth_type.description: Updated auth type (changing this may require providing new credentials).

password_secret_ref.description: Updated secret reference for the Metabase password (for auth_type='password').

api_key_secret_ref.description: Updated secret reference for the Metabase API key/session token (for auth_type='api_key').

status.description: Transition the connection status (active<->disabled; active/disabled<->error as allowed).

last_healthcheck_error.description: Optional healthcheck error details (typically set when transitioning to status='error').
